SOURCE & PROVENANCE

Real transactions. Explicit boundaries.

Olist and collaborators’ anonymized Brazilian marketplace dataset. Historical records from 2016–2018, not current Canadian market evidence. Independent analysis, not commissioned by Olist.

METRIC CONTRACT

What the numbers mean

  • Eligible delivery: delivered status with valid purchase, actual delivery and promised dates; delivery and promise cannot precede purchase.
  • Late: actual delivery calendar date is after the promised date. Same-day delivery is on time.
  • Review: latest answered record per order; ties resolve deterministically. Low score means 1–2 stars; only reviewed eligible orders enter the comparison.
  • Category: an order is assigned to a category only when all items share it. Mixed-category orders remain separate.
  • 90th percentile: nearest-rank delivery duration among eligible delivered orders, measured from purchase.

DECISION AGENDA

Investigate before intervening

  1. Review high late-order volumes with sellers and fulfilment teams.
  2. Separate approval, handoff and transit bottlenecks in follow-up work.
  3. Test proactive delay messages against a control group; measure complaints, contact cost and subsequent orders.

No realized savings, causal improvement or retention uplift is claimed. Open/failed deliveries are excluded from delivery rates; recent purchases may be incompletely observed.
